name: agent-private-landing-zone
description: Private landing zone accelerator with local model support and governed infrastructure workflows

scripts.test: npm run build:ui && npm run test:node && npm run test:ui
scripts.build: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:complete
scripts.build:ui: node -e "const f=require('node:fs');const m='dist/.alz-build-complete';let keep='';try{const v=JSON.parse(f.readFileSync(m,'utf8'));let h='unknown';try{h=require('node:child_process').execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).toString().trim()||'unknown'}catch{}if(v&&v.schemaVersion===1&&typeof v.sourceCommit==='string'&&v.sourceCommit!==''&&(v.sourceCommit===h||h==='unknown'))keep=v.sourceCommit}catch{}f.rmSync(m,{force:true});f.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});f.writeFileSync('dist/.alz-build-ui.keep',keep)" && vite build && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.ui.json scripts/prerender-ui.tsx && node -e "const f=require('node:fs');const keep=f.readFileSync('dist/.alz-build-ui.keep','utf8');f.rmSync('dist/.alz-build-ui.keep',{force:true});if(keep){f.writeFileSync('dist/.alz-build-complete.tmp',JSON.stringify({schemaVersion:1,sourceCommit:keep},null,2)+'\n');f.renameSync('dist/.alz-build-complete.tmp','dist/.alz-build-complete')}"
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json --noEmit && npm run build:ui
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm audit && npm run evidence:migrate && npm run security:check && npm run plugins:check && npm run toolbox:check && npm run discover:aws && npm run discover:azure && npm run discover:unknown && npm run agent:assess && npm run build:aws:terraform && npm run build:unknown && npm run agent:build && npm run agent:change
scripts.agent:assess: tsx src/cli/agent.ts --provider aws --engine terraform --mock brownfield --fixture --request "Review this environment and assess the strongest operational risk."
scripts.agent:build: tsx src/cli/agent.ts --provider aws --engine terraform --mock brownfield --fixture --request "Build additive infrastructure using Terraform."
scripts.agent:change: tsx src/cli/agent.ts --provider azure --engine pulumi --mock greenfield --fixture --approve --request "Deploy an additive platform resource."
scripts.agent:unknown: tsx src/cli/agent.ts --provider aws --engine terraform --mock unknown --fixture --request "Build additive infrastructure using Terraform."
scripts.agent:verbose: tsx src/cli/agent.ts --provider aws --engine terraform --mock brownfield --fixture --verbose --request "Build additive infrastructure using Terraform."
